## Prepare

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(countrycode)
library(cowplot)
library(readxl)
```

## Internet GGI Trend

```{r}
national <- read_csv(here("data/pipeline/result/national/aggregate_files.csv"))

year_average_national <- national %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(substr(date, 1, 4))) %>%
  group_by(gid_0, year, outcome) %>%
  summarise(pred = mean(predicted),
            predicted_error = mean(predicted_error)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(region = countrycode(gid_0, origin = "iso3c", destination = "region"),
         country = countrycode(gid_0, origin = "iso3c", destination = "country.name")) %>%
  group_by(gid_0, outcome) %>%
  arrange(gid_0, outcome, year) %>%
  mutate(total_gain = pred[year == 2025] - pred[year == 2015],
         annual_change = pred - dplyr::lag(pred, default = NA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(gid_0) %>%
  mutate(female_adoption_increase = pred[outcome == "internet_women" & year == 2025] - pred[outcome == "internet_women" & year == 2015]) %>%
  ungroup()


classification <- read_excel(here("data/national/data_refresh/World_Bank_Group_country_classifications_by_income_level.xlsx")) %>%
  slice(1:218) %>%
  select(Code, `Income group`)



year_average_national <- year_average_national %>%
  mutate(
    subregion = case_when(
      gid_0 %in% c("BDI", "COM", "DJI", "ERI", "ETH", "KEN", "MDG", "MWI", "MUS", "MOZ", 
                  "REU", "RWA", "SYC", "SOM", "SSD", "TZA", "UGA", "ZMB", "ZWE") ~ "Eastern Africa",
      
      gid_0 %in% c("AGO", "CMR", "CAF", "TCD", "COD", "COG", "GNQ", "GAB", "STP") ~ "Central Africa",
      
      gid_0 %in% c("BEN", "BFA", "CPV", "CIV", "GMB", "GHA", "GIN", "GNB", "LBR", "MLI", 
                  "MRT", "NER", "NGA", "SEN", "SLE", "TGO") ~ "Western Africa",
      
      gid_0 %in% c("BWA", "LSO", "NAM", "SWZ", "ZAF") ~ "Southern Africa",
      
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(region2 = ifelse(region == "Sub-Saharan Africa", subregion, region))


year_average_national <- year_average_national %>%
  left_join(classification, by = c("gid_0" = "Code"))



year_average_national %>%
  filter(total_gain >= 0.3) %>%
  filter(outcome == "internet_fm_ratio") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = pred, group = country, color = country)) +
  
  # Ribbon for uncertainty bands
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pred - predicted_error, ymax = pred + predicted_error, fill = country), 
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +  # alpha controls transparency, color = NA removes borders
  
  # Lines with distinct colors per country
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Points with the same shape for all countries
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 2) +  # Shape 16 = solid circle
  
  # Labels and Titles
  labs(
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Prediction", 
    title = "Countries with Closing Interent Gender Gap (≥ 0.3 Total Gain)",
    color = "Country",
    fill = "Country"
  ) +

  # Improve theme
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",  # Move legend below the plot
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )


ggsave("internet_fm_ratio_closing_3.png", width = 7.5, height = 5.5)




year_average_national %>%
  filter(outcome == "internet_fm_ratio") %>%
  filter(gid_0 %in% c("AFG", "ERI", "DJI", "TKM")) %>%

  geom_segment(aes(x = 2019, xend = 2018, y = 0.535, yend = 0.43, color = "Eritrea"), 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")), linewidth = 0.9) +

# Compute the regional average trend for baseline
region_select <- year_average_national %>%
  group_by(gid_0, outcome) %>%
  filter(outcome == "internet_fm_ratio") %>%
  mutate(proportional_gain = total_gain[year == 2015]/pred[year == 2015]) %>%
  filter(proportional_gain > 0.25) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(region2) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pull()

regional_avg <- year_average_national %>%
  filter(outcome == "internet_fm_ratio") %>%
  filter(region2 %in% region_select) %>%
  group_by(region2, year) %>%
  summarise(mean_pred = mean(pred, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

year_average_national %>%
  group_by(gid_0, outcome) %>%
  mutate(proportional_gain = total_gain[year == 2015]/pred[year == 2015]) %>%
  filter(proportional_gain > 0.25) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(outcome == "internet_fm_ratio") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pred, group = country, color = country)) +  

  # Ribbon for uncertainty bands
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pred - predicted_error, ymax = pred + predicted_error, fill = country), 
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +  

  # Lines with distinct colors per country
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  
  # Points with the same shape for all countries
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +  
  # **Add the Baseline Trend (Regional Average)**
  geom_line(data = regional_avg, 
            aes(x = year, y = mean_pred, group = region2, linetype = "Regional Average"), 
            color = "#2a3439", linewidth = 1.2) +

  # Labels and Titles
  labs(
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Prediction", 
    title = "Countries with Closing Internet Gender Gap (≥ 25% Increase)",
    color = "Country",
    fill = "Country"
  ) +
  
  # Facet by region while ensuring legends are correctly positioned
  facet_wrap(~region2) +

  # Set x-axis to display every 2 years
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(year_average_national$year, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                  max(year_average_national$year, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                  by = 2)) +

  # Improve theme
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",  
    legend.box = "vertical",  
    legend.margin = margin(t = 10),  
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Regional Average" = "solid"), guide = guide_legend(title = NULL))



ggsave("internet_fm_ratio_closing_2.png", width = 10, height = 12)



year_average_national %>%
```

## Plot for paper: widening + best/worst

```{r}
national <- read_csv(here("data/pipeline/result/national/aggregate_files.csv"))

year_average_national <- national %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(substr(date, 1, 4))) %>%
  group_by(gid_0, year, outcome) %>%
  summarise(pred = mean(predicted),
            predicted_error = mean(predicted_error)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(region = countrycode(gid_0, origin = "iso3c", destination = "region"),
         country = countrycode(gid_0, origin = "iso3c", destination = "country.name")) %>%
  group_by(gid_0, outcome) %>%
  arrange(gid_0, outcome, year) %>%
  mutate(total_gain = pred[year == 2025] - pred[year == 2015],
         annual_change = pred - dplyr::lag(pred, default = NA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(gid_0) %>%
  mutate(female_adoption_increase = pred[outcome == "internet_women" & year == 2025] - pred[outcome == "internet_women" & year == 2015]) %>%
  ungroup()

# Define custom colors
country_colors <- c(
  "Afghanistan" = "#FF6F61",
  "Djibouti"    = "#91B541",
  "Eritrea"     = "#00BFC4",
  "Turkmenistan"= "#C77CFF"
)

country_colors2 <- c(
  "Bangladesh" = "#FDB813",   
  "Turkmenistan" = "#C77CFF"     
)

# -------- Plot 1: Widening Gap --------
widen_plot <- year_average_national %>%
  filter(outcome == "internet_fm_ratio") %>%
  filter(gid_0 %in% c("AFG", "ERI", "DJI", "TKM")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.numeric(year), y = pred, group = country, color = country)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pred - predicted_error, ymax = pred + predicted_error, fill = country), 
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = country_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = country_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2015, 2025, by = 1)) +

  # Annotations
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2019, xend = 2018, y = 0.535, yend = 0.43), 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")), linewidth = 0.9, 
               color = country_colors["Eritrea"]) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2021, xend = 2021.9, y = 0.28, yend = 0.28), 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")), linewidth = 0.9, 
               color = country_colors["Afghanistan"]) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2022, xend = 2022, y = 0.75, yend = 0.83), 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")), linewidth = 0.9, 
               color = country_colors["Turkmenistan"]) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2021, xend = 2021.45, y = 0.61, yend = 0.63), 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")), linewidth = 0.9, 
               color = country_colors["Djibouti"]) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 2016, y = 0.4, label = "Social media shutdown"), 
            hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold", color = country_colors["Eritrea"]) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 2022, y = 0.28, label = "Regime change"), 
            hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold", color = country_colors["Afghanistan"]) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 2021.5, y = 0.86, label = "Intensified internet control"), 
            hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold", color = country_colors["Turkmenistan"]) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 2021.5, y = 0.63, label = "Intensified internet control"), 
            hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold", color = country_colors["Djibouti"]) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Prediction", 
    title = "Countries with Widening Internet Gender Gap",
    color = "Country",
    fill = "Country"
  )

# -------- Plot 2: Best & Worst --------
best_worst_plot <- year_average_national %>%
  filter(outcome == "internet_fm_ratio") %>%
  filter(total_gain == min(total_gain) | total_gain == max(total_gain)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = pred, group = country, color = country)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pred - predicted_error, ymax = pred + predicted_error, fill = country), 
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = country_colors2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = country_colors2) +
  labs(
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Prediction", 
    title = "Best and Worst Performing Countries",
    color = "Country",
    fill = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# -------- Combine with cowplot --------
combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  widen_plot, 
  best_worst_plot, 
  labels = c("A", "B"),  # Optional panel labels
  ncol = 2,              # Arrange vertically; use ncol = 2 for side-by-side
  align = "h"            # Align vertically
)


ggsave("widen_best_worst.png", width = 13, height = 5)
```

## Mobile

```{r}
national <- read_csv(here("data/pipeline/result/national/aggregate_files.csv"))

year_average_national <- national %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(substr(date, 1, 4))) %>%
  group_by(gid_0, year, outcome) %>%
  summarise(pred = mean(predicted),
            predicted_error = mean(predicted_error)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(region = countrycode(gid_0, origin = "iso3c", destination = "region"),
         country = countrycode(gid_0, origin = "iso3c", destination = "country.name")) %>%
  group_by(gid_0, outcome) %>%
  arrange(gid_0, outcome, year) %>%
  mutate(total_gain = pred[year == 2025] - pred[year == 2015],
         annual_change = pred - dplyr::lag(pred, default = NA)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(gid_0) %>%
  mutate(female_adoption_increase = pred[outcome == "internet_women" & year == 2025] - pred[outcome == "internet_women" & year == 2015]) %>%
  ungroup()


classification <- read_excel(here("data/national/data_refresh/World_Bank_Group_country_classifications_by_income_level.xlsx")) %>%
  slice(1:218) %>%
  select(Code, `Income group`)



year_average_national <- year_average_national %>%
  mutate(
    subregion = case_when(
      gid_0 %in% c("BDI", "COM", "DJI", "ERI", "ETH", "KEN", "MDG", "MWI", "MUS", "MOZ", 
                  "REU", "RWA", "SYC", "SOM", "SSD", "TZA", "UGA", "ZMB", "ZWE") ~ "Eastern Africa",
      
      gid_0 %in% c("AGO", "CMR", "CAF", "TCD", "COD", "COG", "GNQ", "GAB", "STP") ~ "Central Africa",
      
      gid_0 %in% c("BEN", "BFA", "CPV", "CIV", "GMB", "GHA", "GIN", "GNB", "LBR", "MLI", 
                  "MRT", "NER", "NGA", "SEN", "SLE", "TGO") ~ "Western Africa",
      
      gid_0 %in% c("BWA", "LSO", "NAM", "SWZ", "ZAF") ~ "Southern Africa",
      
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(region2 = ifelse(region == "Sub-Saharan Africa", subregion, region))


year_average_national <- year_average_national %>%
  left_join(classification, by = c("gid_0" = "Code"))


year_average_national %>%
  filter(total_gain >= 0.2) %>%
  filter(outcome == "mobile_fm_ratio") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = pred, group = country, color = country)) +
  
  # Ribbon for uncertainty bands
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pred - predicted_error, ymax = pred + predicted_error, fill = country), 
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +  # alpha controls transparency, color = NA removes borders
  
  # Lines with distinct colors per country
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Points with the same shape for all countries
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 2) +  # Shape 16 = solid circle
  
  # Labels and Titles
  labs(
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Prediction", 
    title = "Countries with Closing Mobile Gender Gap (≥ 0.2 Total Gain)",
    color = "Country",
    fill = "Country"
  ) +

  # Improve theme
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",  # Move legend below the plot
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )


ggsave("mobile_fm_ratio_closing_2.png", width = 7.5, height = 5.5)



year_average_national %>%
  filter(outcome == "mobile_fm_ratio") %>%
  filter(gid_0 %in% c("AFG", "ERI", "DJI", "TKM")) %>%

year_average_national %>%
  filter(outcome == "mobile_fm_ratio") %>%
  filter(total_gain <= 0.1) %>%
  group_by(gid_0) %>%
  mutate(mean_pred = mean(pred)) %>%
  filter(mean_pred < 0.8) %>%
  filter(gid_0 != "YEM") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = pred, group = country, color = country)) +
  
  # Ribbon for uncertainty bands
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pred - predicted_error, ymax = pred + predicted_error, fill = country), 
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +  # alpha controls transparency, color = NA removes borders
```
